milestone: v0.5 eight-way indoor gas blast feel
status: Eight-way on-foot attack approved, prototype numeric values provisional until Atari800 playtest; road gas attack remains four-way

controls.fire_held: stop walking, enter aim stance, read joystick each frame
controls.aim: Eight directions: up, up-right, right, down-right, down, down-left, left, up-left; a new valid direction starts/restarts the four-frame windup.
controls.diagonal_joystick: A two-axis joystick diagonal is its own valid aim (never converted to a cardinal direction); maintain exactly one chosen direction while held.
controls.no_direction: show undecided aiming pose; do not attack or consume gas
controls.release_before_windup: cancel with no attack, no resource cost, immediate walking
controls.automatic_discharge: One burst occurs after the chosen valid cardinal OR diagonal direction remains stable for 4 observed video frames during the same FIRE hold.
controls.after_discharge: holding FIRE holds stance but NEVER repeats; releasing FIRE permits walking once recovery expires
controls.fire_pressed_during_cooldown_or_empty: enter aiming stance, show READY/SUPPLY feedback; never queue a later discharge automatically while same press is held

animation.orientation: Face away from one of eight aimed directions; jeans-clad backside points toward chosen cardinal or diagonal target.
animation.windup: pose rotates and rear visibly protrudes; 4 frame windup; at least 2 pose frames or corresponding temporary PMG overlay
animation.visual: animated expanding GAS CLOUD, not a projectile or single narrow ray
animation.origin: just outside Billy's rear, no smoke drawn on Billy hitbox
animation.cloud_candidates: For aim vector (dx,dy), perpendicular (-dy,dx), generate center+flanks at p+d*aim+k*perp; wave1 d=1 k=0; wave2 d=2 k=-1,0,+1; wave3 d=3 k=-1,0,+1; clip to bounds and traverse only through passable/visible predecessors.
animation.cloud_damage: each enemy contacted at most once per burst, including if it remains inside expanding cloud
animation.rendering: v0.4 uses Billy GTIA player0 PMG at BC00; add pose frames and optional player1 rear overlay ONLY during Stage 1 if PMG memory/OS budget safe; gas cloud as temporary overlay glyphs with underlying terrain/actors restored

sfx.description: short original POKEY airy/noisy 10-frame puff whoosh on discharge, protect accepted title/cutscene music registers and timings
sfx.if_unavailable: clearly document and leave SFX separately tunable; gameplay must remain playable

animation.pose_requirements: Eight distinguishable blast orientations (four cardinal + four diagonal) and visible backside during windup; safe original in-game PMG solutions welcome.

cloud_geometry.coordinate_space: integer tile cells; Billy hitbox center tile is origin
cloud_geometry.diagonal_occlusion: supercover line-of-sight from origin to each candidate, with D/X and solid tiles treated as opaque; each diagonal step additionally requires both adjacent orthogonal cells passable (no corner clipping)

combat.area: Eight-direction growing cloud: 7-cell cone at max for each cardinal or diagonal aim; multiple current-room workers may be hit.
combat.collision: tile or inset AABB contact with cloud cells when each wave becomes active; only current room; no hit through solid or door/exit markers
combat.enemy_hit_limit: each affected worker can be hit once per burst; multiple workers may be affected
combat.knockback_direction: Same one of eight (dx,dy) unit tile-step directions as the cloud; worker moves away from Billy.
combat.collision_solid: stop at last walkable tile and show 4-frame bonk/splat; stun still applies
combat.collision_other_worker: stop before occupied tile; stagger blocking worker for 24 frames, do not chain-push or overlap enemies
combat.knockback_persist: worker global coordinates and room state persist, frame-by-frame during push; no teleport or duplicate
combat.controls_during_knockback: Billy may move after required recovery/release even if effect still active
combat.diagonal_knockback: Each diagonal push step checks target tile and both axis-adjacent orthogonal corner-clearance tiles (all walkable and non-door/non-exit); stop before obstacles, D/X, room border or another worker.

resource.refill_policy: recharge one at a time up to max; stage restart resets to full; do not reset on room transition
resource.hud: show GAS 0/3..3/3 and brief READY/COOLING/EMPTY messaging in two existing bottom status rows; avoid replacing room tiles
resource.empty_feedback: no blast, no resource cost; short HUD flash; player can recover by walking/releasing
resource.fallback_ability: movement/escape route always reachable without charges

preservation.player_movement: keep user-approved v0.4 Q4/16 sub-tile smooth 8-way walking, wall sliding and 6x6 hitbox
preservation.room_structure: three 40x22 fixed full-screen rooms, four reciprocal doorway transitions and backtracking
preservation.enemies: reuse v0.3 three unique workers with activation, AI cadences, room follow, stun/grace, caught and restart
preservation.opening: preserve original approved Title v1, Meet the Crew and Arrival, their START/FIRE cutscene controls, Arcade Rock and Funky Gas Attack
non_goals: new enemy types or room spawns

numeric_contract_checks: 8 aim directions, exact joystick vector mapping, diagonals are independent valid aims
aim after pressing FIRE still produces one shot
exactly one shot per FIRE press regardless of hold length
diagonal aim directly triggers after 4 stable frames, including FIRE pressed before direction
release early does not spend a charge
recovery and cooldown independent of FIRE release
max3-tile animated knockback and impact checks
never trapped with permanently zero gas
no diagonal corner clipping in cloud supercover occlusion or knockback; four-way road attacks unchanged
runtime_tests: v0.4 smooth movement exact speed and diagonals preserved
one-button FIRE aim without movement and release returns to walking
direction change during windup resets charge
no cloud through counters/walls or across rooms
cloud visibly expands, is restored on end
hit several workers once each and stun
animated knockback collision with furniture and other enemy
in-game POKEY effect does not corrupt intro music
rendering correct with active PMG and cloud
XEX segments safe, CPU bounded on Atari800 64KB
all 8 blast directions individually and joystick diagonal before/after FIRE; distinct pose/gas/knockback vectors and blocked diagonal corners
playtest_metrics: visibility of butt pose and gas cloud
perceived punch of knockback and collision
number of shots and empty charge waits
diagonal aim discoverability and blast coverage without corner clipping
